question: What structural characterization is given to the sub-base in this teaching?
premises: The preceding proportions have been described.
The sub-base is declared to have six limbs.
The teaching is addressed to the foremost twice-born.
inference: The sub-base described above is characterized as having six limbs.
plain_english: Thus, O best of the twice-born, the sub-base is declared to have six limbs.
